meta.title: Infinite Tic-Tac-Toe
meta.description: Only 3 pieces per player: place a fourth and your oldest one disappears.

rules: Rules: each player can only have {{max}} pieces on the board. When you place a fourth, your oldest piece disappears (the blinking one). Get three in a row to win.

streak.rules: Streak: each consecutive win against the CPU adds 1. Lose or quit a game in progress and it goes back to 0.
